title: IT Recruiter
description:
**Job Title:** IT Recruiter

**Location:** Thrissur, Koratty

**Industry:** Software / IT

**Job Type:** Full-time

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a skilled IT Recruiter to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in IT recruitment, with a deep understanding of the technology landscape and a keen eye for identifying top talent. As an IT Recruiter, you will be responsible for sourcing, screening, and engaging candidates for various IT positions within our organization. You will work closely with hiring managers to understand their needs and preferences, and you will play a key role in helping us build a strong team of IT professionals.

**Experience Requirements**

* **Relevant Experience:** 3+ years in recruitment, with 2 years specifically in IT recruitment.
* **Added Advantage:** Cybersecurity domain experience.

**Key Responsibilities, Deliverables / Outcomes**

* Partner with hiring managers to understand their technical requirements and preferences for open positions.
* Utilize various sourcing methods to attract top IT talent, including job boards, social media, networking events, and employee referrals.
* Screen resumes and conduct initial phone interviews to assess candidate technical skills, experience, and fit for the role.
* Coordinate and schedule interviews with hiring managers and technical teams.
* Manage the candidate experience throughout the recruitment process, ensuring timely communication and providing feedback.
* Negotiate offers and facilitate the hiring process, including background checks and onboarding.
* Build and maintain a pipeline of qualified candidates for current and future hiring needs.
* Stay up to date on industry trends and best practices in IT recruitment.

**Key Skills**

* Proven experience in IT/Cyber Recruitment Experience.
* Strong Requirement Analysis & Screening skills.
* Strong sourcing and networking abilities.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency in ATS and recruitment tools.

**Interested candidates are requested to share their updated resume to vincy@affable.in or contact 9048151003**

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹600,000.00 per year

title: HR Recruiter
description:
HR Recruiter

**Company:** Sealand Maritime Group  
**Location:** [Saudi Arabia / Bahrain]  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

About the Role

Sealand Maritime Group is looking for a proactive and results-driven **HR Recruiter** to manage end-to-end recruitment activities across our marine, industrial, technical, logistics, and corporate operations.

The successful candidate will be responsible for identifying, attracting, screening, and coordinating suitable candidates for both **technical and non-technical positions**, while maintaining a strong talent pipeline for the company's growing operations.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage the complete recruitment process from **manpower request to joining**.
* Understand job requirements and prepare accurate job descriptions and job postings.
* Source candidates through recruitment portals, LinkedIn, social media, databases, agencies, referrals, and other channels.
* Screen CVs and shortlist candidates based on technical qualifications, experience, salary expectations, and availability.
* Conduct initial HR interviews and coordinate technical interviews with department heads.
* Maintain an active database of qualified candidates for current and future vacancies.
* Coordinate interviews, assessments, document collection, offers, and joining formalities.
* Negotiate salary and employment terms within approved company guidelines.
* Follow up with candidates throughout the recruitment process and ensure a positive candidate experience.
* Coordinate mobilization and onboarding of selected candidates.
* Maintain recruitment records and update the HR/ERP system.
* Track recruitment KPIs including vacancies, CVs received, interviews, selections, offer acceptance, and joining status.
* Coordinate with department heads to understand manpower requirements and recruitment priorities.
* Develop recruitment pipelines for critical technical positions.
* Coordinate with recruitment agencies when required and monitor agency performance.
* Support recruitment for urgent project and manpower requirements.
* Conduct reference checks and verify candidate credentials where required.
* Maintain confidentiality of candidate and employee information.
* Prepare regular recruitment status reports for management.

Positions You May Recruit For

The candidate should be comfortable recruiting across a wide range of positions, including:

**Marine & Technical**

* Marine Engineers
* Marine Technicians
* HFO/Diesel Mechanics
* Electrical & Electromechanical Technicians
* Automation Engineers
* Navigation & Communication Technicians
* Firefighting & Lifesaving Technicians
* HVAC Technicians
* Welders & Fabricators
* Inspectors

**Operations & Logistics**

* Drivers
* Heavy Equipment Operators
* Logistics Coordinators
* Warehouse Staff
* Ship Chandlers
* FMCG/Provisions Coordinators
* Procurement & Purchasing Staff

**Corporate**

* Sales & Business Development
* Accounts & Finance
* HR & Administration
* IT/MIS
* Management and support functions

Requirements

* **2–5 years of experience** in recruitment or HR, preferably in marine, engineering, construction, industrial, oil & gas, logistics, or manpower-intensive industries.
* Strong experience in **technical and blue-collar recruitment**.
* Good understanding of job portals, LinkedIn, CV databases, and candidate sourcing techniques.
* Strong interviewing and candidate screening skills.
* Good knowledge of MS Office, particularly Excel.
* Experience with HRMS/ERP systems is an advantage.
* Strong English communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple vacancies simultaneously.
* Strong follow-up and coordination skills.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet recruitment deadlines.

Preferred Candidate

We are looking for someone who is:

* **Proactive rather than reactive**
* Strong at sourcing and networking
* Target-oriented and results-driven
* Good at identifying technically suitable candidates
* Persistent with candidate follow-ups
* Highly organized
* Confidential and trustworthy
* Comfortable dealing with both senior professionals and large-volume manpower recruitment
* Able to work independently with minimal supervision

Key Performance Indicators

Performance will be measured based on:

* Time to fill vacancies
* Quality of candidates shortlisted
* Offer-to-joining conversion
* Recruitment cost
* Number of qualified candidates sourced
* Recruitment deadline compliance
* Candidate retention after joining
* Effectiveness of technical manpower sourcing
* Recruitment pipeline strength

How to Apply

Interested candidates are requested to submit their CV along with:

* Current location
* Current salary
* Expected salary
* Notice period
* Total recruitment experience
* Industries/positions recruited for
* Number of vacancies handled per month

Work Location: In person
